_template_notes.purpose: Cross-skill artifact PRIMARY (CORE-036). Phase 8 output. Consumed bởi 4 skills downstream qua --from-cmi: wf-verify-sync, wf-fix-bugs, wf-implement-feature, wf-prepare-deployment. v3.0 schema bump (2026-05-16): thêm e2e_execution_summary + scenarios_artifacts[] cho Phase 9-10 E2E Scenario Engine — giữ ALL fields v1 + v2 (lanes_v2, wave_breakdown, group_breakdown, logistics_critical_signals_count, violations, regression_scope, gap_artifacts_suggested, consumers_recommended_actions, summary, audit_chain) cho backward-compat consumer fallback. PHẢI có $schema='integrity-impact-v3' + audit_chain.source + audit_chain.checksum + git_commit + git_branch + author. Tham chiếu v3.0-e2e-integration-plan.md §4.4 + §6.
populate: scope: scope từ session (type + modules[])
profile: profile từ session
lanes_v2.active: 27 CD IDs đã dispatch (26 v2 + CD41 nếu profile=deep|exhaustive)
lanes_v2.skipped: 9 CD IDs SKIPPED (CD8, CD10, CD12, CD14, CD19-22, CD27)
lanes_v2.skeleton: 5 CD IDs v3-deferred (CD32-CD36) — KHÔNG dispatch v2/v3
wave_breakdown.wave_X: {lane_count, pass_count, fail_count, timeout_count, overall_pct, gate_status} per wave từ wave-status.json (wave 3 deep mở rộng 6→7 lanes với CD41)
group_breakdown.{core,frontend,backend,ux,logistics,compliance,implementation,e2e_synth}: {lane_ids[], avg_coverage_pct, status, violations_count} — v3 thêm 'e2e_synth' group cho CD41
logistics_critical_signals_count: signals từ CD28/CD30/CD31/CD37/CD38/CD39/CD40 — ★★★ logistics-critical aggregate
schema_version_compat.readable_by: ['integrity-impact-v1','integrity-impact-v2','integrity-impact-v3'] — hint cho consumer detect logic
coverage_matrix_summary: rút gọn từ coverage-matrix.json — {overall_pct, below_threshold_dims[], status}

violations[]: top 10 violations severity-weighted (MUST=4, HIGH=3, MEDIUM=2, LOW=1) từ Phase 5 aggregation — {id (CMI-V-XXX), dim, invariant_id, severity, rule, affected_modules[], affected_files[], suggested_fix_ref}
regression_scope: rút gọn từ regression-map.json — {changed_files_count, predicted_affected_modules[], test_plan_count, mode}
gap_artifacts_suggested[]: từ gap-suggestions.json post-CDG — {kind, id, status=accepted|rejected|pending_user_accept, path, target, reason?} — v3 thêm kind='e2e_scenario_fix' từ Phase 10 loop-back
consumers_recommended_actions: 4 keys cho 4 consumers — string mô tả action recommended cho mỗi consumer (tính dựa final_status + must_violations + overall_pct + profile + e2e_execution_summary)

e2e_execution_summary (NEW v3): null nếu KHÔNG --exec-scenarios. Populated bởi Phase 9 + Phase 10 nếu execute Playwright — {exec_enabled, scenarios_synthesized, scenarios_executed, pass_count, auto_corrected_count, fail_count, quarantined_count, cross_module_count, phase9_duration_ms, phase10_duration_ms, loop_back_suggestions_count, top_failure_types[]}

scenarios_artifacts[] (NEW v3): [] nếu KHÔNG --exec-scenarios. Populated với 1 entry per scenario — {scenario_id, scenario_file, feat_id_inferred, modules_involved, cross_module, source_violation_ids, source_invariant_id, execution_status, screenshot_paths[], resolution_path}
audit_chain.source: path tới integrity-status.json (SSOT)
audit_chain.checksum: sha256 của artifact này
audit_chain.git_commit: HEAD commit SHA
audit_chain.git_branch: current branch
audit_chain.author: {email, name} từ git config
_template_notes.backward_compat_contract: Consumer skills (wf-verify-sync, wf-fix-bugs, wf-implement-feature, wf-prepare-deployment) PHẢI detect $schema field: nếu = 'integrity-impact-v1' → đọc bằng v1 reader (chỉ truy cập fields v1); nếu = 'integrity-impact-v2' → đọc bằng v1 reader HOẶC v2 reader (truy cập thêm lanes_v2/wave_breakdown/group_breakdown/logistics_critical_signals_count); nếu = 'integrity-impact-v3' → đọc bằng v1/v2/v3 reader (v3 thêm e2e_execution_summary + scenarios_artifacts — v1/v2 readers ignore 2 fields này). Producer wf-cmi v3 LUÔN ghi $schema='integrity-impact-v3' + đầy đủ fields v1 + v2 + v3. Khi KHÔNG có --exec-scenarios → e2e_execution_summary=null + scenarios_artifacts=[] để consumer biết exec không chạy.
_template_notes.version_bump_coordination: v2→v3 bump (2026-05-16): KHÔNG break — 4 consumers vẫn read được bằng v1/v2 reader (fields v1+v2 100% preserved). Nếu consumer muốn opt-in v3 features (e2e_execution_summary, scenarios_artifacts) → update consumer reader logic + _contract.json mention v3 schema. Tham chiếu Stage 3 §G3.3 backward-compat mock test (v1/v2/v3 reader ALL pass đọc v3 artifact).

schema_version_compat.v1_compat_note: All v1 fields preserved — v1 readers ignore lanes_v2/wave_breakdown/group_breakdown/logistics_critical_signals_count/e2e_execution_summary/scenarios_artifacts. Consumer detect via $schema field.
schema_version_compat.v2_compat_note: All v2 fields preserved — v2 readers ignore e2e_execution_summary/scenarios_artifacts. Consumer detect via $schema field.
schema_version_compat.v3_compat_note: v3 fields are nullable. When --exec-scenarios=off: e2e_execution_summary=null + scenarios_artifacts=[]. Consumer downstream can safely consume v3 artifact với v1/v2 reader logic — KHÔNG break.

wave_1.description: Wave 1 — Graphs (10 lanes max: CD1-CD7, CD11, CD16, CD17)

wave_2.description: Wave 2 — Cross-layer (10 lanes max: CD13, CD15, CD18, CD23-CD25, CD28, CD30, CD31, CD37)

wave_3.description: Wave 3 — Final cross-ref (6 lanes: CD9, CD26, CD29, CD38, CD39, CD40)

logistics_critical_signals_count.note: Aggregate signals từ 7 logistics-critical lanes (CD28 MDM + CD30 Time&Numbering + CD31 Money&Tax + CD37 Regulatory + CD38 UI Implementation + CD39 Error UX + CD40 Print&Export). wf-prepare-deployment dùng cờ này để block release nếu must_severity_count > 0.

consumers_recommended_actions.wf-verify-sync: Re-run --from-cmi để validate impl_status vs invariants mới và regression-affected modules. Đọc lanes_v2.active để biết coverage dims đã đo. v3 thêm: nếu e2e_execution_summary.fail_count > 0 → re-validate REQ-ID của scenarios_artifacts[].source_invariant_id. (v1 reader: chỉ cần đọc violations[] + regression_scope)
consumers_recommended_actions.wf-fix-bugs: Seed Phase 1 với violations[] MUST severity — ưu tiên logistics_critical_signals_count.must_severity_count cao. v3 thêm: scenarios_artifacts[execution_status='FAIL'] làm seed lane QD1/QD5 (UI bugs từ runtime verify). (v1 reader: chỉ đọc violations[] MUST severity)
consumers_recommended_actions.wf-implement-feature: Warn nếu touch entities/modules trong violations[].affected_modules — review business-invariants.json trước khi code. v3 thêm: warn nếu touch modules có scenarios_artifacts[execution_status='FAIL'] — review resolution-report.md trước khi code. (v1 reader: chỉ check violations[].affected_modules)
consumers_recommended_actions.wf-prepare-deployment: v3 logic: BLOCK release nếu (a) logistics_critical_signals_count.must_severity_count > 0 HOẶC (b) wave_breakdown.wave_X.gate_status == 'FAIL_THRESHOLD' HOẶC (c) coverage < threshold_overall_pct_per_profile[profile] HOẶC (d v3 NEW) e2e_execution_summary.fail_count > 0. (v1 reader: BLOCK nếu coverage_matrix_summary.status == 'FAIL')
